If functional_sim is treated as runtime numerical acceptance instead of the compile-only VCS acceptance mode, the gate could be prematurely promoted without current-source compile/elaborate/link evidence.

Derived checks such as data_order_trace_check, transfer_count_check, addr_map_check, and deadlock_watchdog depend on functional_sim instrumentation/trace evidence; missing trace fields would leave them not_run rather than pass.

Missing operator-leaf and single-layer promotion certificates are not current-stage blockers under stage_gate_policy, but they become mandatory Stage7 bottom-up execution obligations before board closure.
Cross-layer consistency risk remains between Stage5 memory/runtime layout and the exact discovered AXI/DDR wrapper image layout; it must be reconciled after case_board_interface_discovery.
Any tolerance or golden-boundary change derived from DUT output, or any expansion of DUT scope beyond Transformer blocks, would require approval and reversion.
If the DAG only contains a global case_stage_leaf_static aggregator, a leaf may be promoted without its own per-leaf static, boundary, functional, golden, and semantic evidence.

split_reason: The verification_artifacts stage plans three distinct repair-loop maturity layers with different gate boundaries: operator leaf modules, single transformer-layer kernel, and board AXI/DDR wrapped system. Each layer can be planned independently against the Stage 3/4/5 artifacts, followed by a cross-layer evidence-gate auditor. SACG memory has no active retry, backtrack, or contamination blockers, so parallel planning is safe.
